Image resizer

Choose images and enter a width, a height, or both.

How it works

  1. Choose your images.
  2. Enter a width, a height, or both.
  3. Click Resize and download the files.

Good to know

  • Enlarging a small picture makes it blurry. Resizing down gives the best quality.
  • The file type stays the same: JPG stays JPG, PNG stays PNG.

Common questions

How do I resize an image to 1000x1000?

Enter 1000 for the width and 1000 for the height, untick Keep proportions, and click Resize. The picture will be stretched if it is not square.

Will resizing change my original file?

No. You download a new copy and your original stays as it is.
